label: Eligible primary study
definition: Meets frozen inclusion criteria and advances to extraction.

label: Not materially AR
definition: No separable or materially relevant augmented-reality contribution.

label: VR only
definition: Pure virtual-reality study without separable AR evidence.

label: Secondary literature
definition: Review/survey/meta-analysis/editorial; route relevant records to review-of-reviews layer.

label: Non-research record
definition: News/tutorial/commercial/commentary or insufficient research report type.

label: Bibliographic duplicate
definition: Same report already represented by canonical record.

label: Noncanonical companion
definition: Same study family without materially additional evidence.

label: Language limitation
definition: Full text not available in English.

label: Needs full-text/adjudication
definition: Insufficient information for a defensible include/exclude decision at current stage.
